phrases.latin: Hoc nimis dulce est; nōlō amplius.
phrases.english: This is too sweet; I don’t want any more.

phrases.latin: sed vel utī puerīs absinthia taetra medentēs cum dare cōnantur, prius ōrās pōcula circum contingunt mellis dulcī flāvōque liquōre
phrases.english: but as doctors, when they try to give children foul wormwood, first touch the rims of the cup all round with the sweet golden liquid of honey

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 158, 280.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
